aboutGame.title: What is Icycle on Thin Ice?
paragraphs: Icycle on Thin Ice is a physics-based precision platformer from indie studio Damp Gnat. You play as Dennis, a shivering cyclist in his underwear pedaling a tiny bicycle through a surreal, post-apocalyptic ice age in search of love.

Every stage is built around momentum: the bike carries real inertia across packed snow and slick blue ice, and Dennis's umbrella doubles as a glider that turns deadly falls into controlled crossings. Collect Ice Shards, buy upgrades and outfits, earn badges, and unlock hidden bonus levels as the frozen dreamscape bends around you.

modules.name: Icycle On Thin Ice Beginner Guide
modules.description: Introduce the core controls, movement, ice hazards, collectibles, and basic progression so new players can understand how to start each level and survive the precision-platforming sections.

highlights.detail: Feather the pedals instead of holding them to keep control on slick ice and steep slopes
Tap jump for a short hop, then hold jump in mid-air to open the umbrella and glide
Use the reverse direction as a brake early, since ice makes stopping distances much longer
Collect floating Ice Chips along the main path to spend later in the wardrobe shop
Watch brittle ledges and icicles, because they collapse moments after your wheels touch them
Reach the exit gate, then replay the stage to clean up missed shards and badges

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Icycle on Thin Ice.

items.question: What is Icycle on Thin Ice?
items.answer: Icycle on Thin Ice is a physics-based precision platformer by Damp Gnat. You play as Dennis, a shivering cyclist pedaling a tiny bicycle through a surreal frozen apocalypse in search of love, balancing momentum, traction, and umbrella glides across collapsing ice.

items.question: Who developed Icycle on Thin Ice?
items.answer: It was created by the indie studio Damp Gnat. The game began as the mobile title Icycle and was later expanded into the enhanced Icycle: On Thin Ice released for PC and Mac.

items.question: How do I control Dennis?
items.answer: Pedal with the direction keys, tap jump for a short hop, and hold jump in mid-air to open the umbrella and glide. Reverse direction to brake, but start early because ice makes stopping distances long.

items.question: What are Ice Shards used for in Icycle on Thin Ice?
items.answer: Ice Shards are the in-game currency. You collect them across each stage and spend them in the wardrobe shop on outfits, accessories, and functional gear such as the Vacuum and upgraded umbrellas.

items.question: How do I unlock bonus levels?
items.answer: Bonus stages in Icycle on Thin Ice unlock through milestones such as collecting 80 hidden shards in Chapters 1-3, earning 3-star ratings on five straight levels, or finding hidden love letters behind breakable walls.

items.question: Does Icycle on Thin Ice have a hard mode?
items.answer: Yes. Hard mode places checkpoints farther apart, makes fragile platforms collapse in under a second, and removes most tolerance for mistakes, so momentum control matters even more.
